MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 10

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 75
   D. 40

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
